summary: Iteration 13: Multi-device WebAuthn bug fix E2E (per-device passkeys). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_webauthn.py -n 0: 9/9 PASSED in 0.43s (includes new test_multi_device_register_and_targeted_unlock). Frontend E2E via Playwright with TWO separate browser contexts (Device A 'Android' + Device B 'iPhone'), each with its own CDP session + WebAuthn.enable + addVirtualAuthenticator (ctap2/internal/hasResidentKey/hasUserVerification/isUserVerified/automaticPresenceSimulation), separate storage. All 9 multi-device flow checks PASSED: (1) A: PIN 1234 -> Settings -> click biometric-enable-button -> switches to biometric-disable-button, biometric-this-device-status='Is device pe enabled hai'. (2) B (fresh context): lock screen HIDES biometric-unlock-button (bug fix verified - previously this button was shown domain-wide). (3) B: PIN 1234 -> Settings -> biometric-enable-button present with biometric-this-device-status EXACTLY '1 device pe enabled hai — is device pe bhi enable karo' (THE PRIMARY BUG FIX - previously showed Disable only). biometric-disable-button absent. (4) B: click Enable -> register second passkey -> status flips to 'Is device pe enabled hai (+1 aur device)'. (5) B: lock -> biometric-unlock-button now visible -> click -> unlocks without PIN entry. (6) A: lock -> its own biometric-unlock-button still works -> unlocks (passkey untouched by B's registration). (7) A: Settings shows biometric-remove-all-button ('Sab devices se biometric hatao') because count=2. (8) Click remove-all -> biometric-enable-button reappears. (9) After remove-all, BOTH devices' lock screens hide biometric-unlock-button. Final DB state: 0 webauthn credentials (verified via GET /api/webauthn/status -> {enabled:false,count:0,credential_ids:[]}). Existing PNB/SBI logins untouched. NOTE: initial run of E2E failed at step 3 because assertion fired before /webauthn/status fetch resolved on B's fresh Settings dialog (both branches render biometric-enable-button while bioStatus=null). Fixed test by polling biometric-this-device-status text with a 8s timeout. This is a real minor UX consideration (see review comment) but not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: ChangePinDialog.jsx: while bioStatus is null (first render before /webauthn/status resolves), the component optimistically renders the 'else' branch with Enable button and 'Fingerprint/face se vault unlock karo' text. On a slow network Device B could briefly show the wrong message before flipping to '1 device pe enabled hai — is device pe bhi enable karo'. Consider a small loading skeleton or gating with `bioStatus != null` to avoid a flash of incorrect text. Low severity (UX polish, ~200ms window).

webauthn.js unlockWithPasskey posts {credential_id: getLocalCredId()} even when null. Backend handles both cases (test_multi_device covers null via empty {}), but sending {credential_id: null} explicitly is slightly noisier than omitting the key. Cosmetic.

deviceBioEnabled() correctly gates PinScreen biometric button; note however that if backend /webauthn/status fails (network error), status stays null and bio button correctly hides — good defensive default.

biometric-remove-all-button visibility condition `(bioStatus?.count || 0) > (thisDeviceEnabled ? 1 : 0)` is correct: shows when there is at least one OTHER device besides current, i.e. useful cross-device cleanup scenario. Verified visible on Device A when 2 devices registered.
Prior iteration_12 review comments still applicable (PinScreen keydown listener missing dep array; RP_ID env override for prod).

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 webauthn tests pass, incl. new multi-device targeted-unlock test)

seed_data_creation: During E2E: registered 2 WebAuthn credentials (A + B). All removed via biometric-remove-all-button click; final backend state verified 0 credentials. No credentials/cards/insurance/logins rows added. PNB/SBI existing seed intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-device WebAuthn E2E pattern: browser.new_context() per device (fresh viewport, storage). For each context: ctx.new_cdp_session(page) + WebAuthn.enable + WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator {protocol:ctap2,transport:internal,hasResidentKey:true,hasUserVerification:true,isUserVerified:true,automaticPresenceSimulation:true}. LocalStorage key is 'vault_bio_cred' (per-device credential id). RP ID = vault-login-6.preview.emergentagent.com via x-forwarded-host. IMPORTANT: when asserting biometric-this-device-status text, POLL for expected substring — dialog renders immediately with bioStatus=null, actual status arrives ~200-500ms later; both branches show biometric-enable-button so waiting on selector alone is insufficient. To lock vault, use lock-button (present in main app) or evaluate localStorage.removeItem('vault_token')+reload as fallback. After registering a passkey the localStorage 'vault_bio_cred' gets the credential id; deviceBioEnabled(status) requires both localStorage id AND server credential_ids to include it (gates PinScreen bio button correctly).
rca of the issue: N/A — the multi-device bug fix (per-device credential tracking via localStorage 'vault_bio_cred' + credential_ids array in /webauthn/status + per-credential DELETE via ?credential_id=) is fully working end-to-end. All 6 required flows validated across two independent Playwright contexts with independent CDP virtual authenticators.
